notes: Cross-verse split with JOS.22.7. Both verses write one English connective for a waw standing immediately before a discourse adverb. JOS.22.7 gives 'Moreover' to גַּם and leaves the waw unrepresented; this verse gave 'Howbeit' to the waw and left אַךְ unrepresented. Rule 14's closing paragraph directs that the adverb take the word writing its own lexeme and the waw take the connective left over, and rule 11 gives a function word first to the morpheme whose sense it carries. 'Howbeit' writes אַךְ's own restrictive lexeme, so the adverb takes it and the waw is the morpheme the ASV leaves unrendered. Two units change; the rest of the verse is unaltered.
